subject: math
question: 求证 $n$ 阶实矩阵 $\pmb{A}$ 是对称矩阵的充分必要条件是 $A^2 = A^{\mathrm{T}}A$

steps.text: 分析 必要性显然；对于充分性，需证明 $A = A^{T}$ 。如果 $\operatorname{tr}(A - A^{\mathrm{T}})(A - A^{\mathrm{T}})^{\mathrm{T}} = 0$ ，问题就解决了。
必要性显然，下证充分性.

方法1 若 $A^2 = A^{\mathrm{T}}A$ ，则 $A^2$ 是对称矩阵，且有

$$
(\boldsymbol {A} - \boldsymbol {A} ^ {\mathrm{T}}) (\boldsymbol {A} - \boldsymbol {A} ^ {\mathrm{T}}) ^ {\mathrm{T}} = (\boldsymbol {A} - \boldsymbol {A} ^ {\mathrm{T}}) (\boldsymbol {A} ^ {\mathrm{T}} - \boldsymbol {A}) = \boldsymbol {A} \boldsymbol {A} ^ {\mathrm{T}} + \boldsymbol {A} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {A} - 2 \boldsymbol {A} ^ {2} = \boldsymbol {A} \boldsymbol {A} ^ {\mathrm{T}} - \boldsymbol {A} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {A}.
$$

两边求迹，有

$$
\operatorname{tr} \left(\boldsymbol {A} - \boldsymbol {A} ^ {\mathrm{T}}\right) \left(\boldsymbol {A} - \boldsymbol {A} ^ {\mathrm{T}}\right) ^ {\mathrm{T}} = 0,
$$

所以 $A-A^{T}=0$ ，即 $A=A^{T}$ .

方法2 等式 $A^2 = A^{\mathrm{T}}A$ 两边求迹，有

$$
\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \sum_ {j = 1} ^ {n} a _ {i j} a _ {j i} = \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \sum_ {j = 1} ^ {n} a _ {i j} ^ {2},
$$

两边乘以2得，

$$
\begin{array}{l} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \sum_ {j = 1} ^ {n} 2 a _ {i j} a _ {j i} = \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \sum_ {j = 1} ^ {n} 2 a _ {i j} ^ {2} = \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \sum_ {j = 1} ^ {n} (a _ {i j} ^ {2} + a _ {j i} ^ {2}) \\ \Rightarrow \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \sum_ {j = 1} ^ {n} (a _ {i j} - a _ {j i}) ^ {2} = 0 \Rightarrow a _ {i j} = a _ {j i} \Rightarrow A = A ^ {\mathrm{T}}. \end{array}
$$

meta.commentary:
评注 注意结论：若 A 为实矩阵，则 $\mathrm{tr}(AA^{\mathrm{T}})\geqslant0$ 。等号成立的充要条件是 A=0 。

推论：实矩阵 $A = 0 \Leftrightarrow AA^{\mathrm{T}} = 0$
